regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, healthcare-led tape: Big Pharma, Health Care (EW), Defensives, and Consumer Staples all rank in the top 5, are eligible via the trend gate, and carry high durability (0.78–0.84) and full/healthy breadth. Momentum ranks are a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the headline theme is crowded (>1.4 z), so this is a trend-health and staying-power read, not a return forecast. The AI/semiconductor complex — including last cycle's Memory/HBM leader — has collapsed to the bottom and lost trend-gate eligibility.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Energy theme's thin-breadth leadership (rank 6, eligible, uncrowded) can broaden beyond its single carrier of trend: I'm watching for breadth on US Energy Complex to climb from 0.0 to at least 0.3 while staying trend-gate eligible — that would retire the watch and justify a more durable defensive-diversifier read; if breadth stays at zero over the next two weeks, the watch retires as a fragile, concentration-driven blip.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme, trend-gate eligible, durable (0.84), and exhibits full breadth (1.0). It behaves as a defensive, low-vol leader in a risk-off tape. Crowding (1.46 z) is a size-down caution, not a fade signal.
theses.dissent: Crowding is elevated; pharma leadership frequently reverses when a macro surprise resets the narrative, and the proxy PPH can lag the weighted headline theme on a single-name overhang.

falsifier.text: PPH prints a lower low on a weekly close while the S&P 500 does not before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight health care is eligible, trend-healthy (0.78), and broad (0.917), which reduces single-name concentration risk versus the crowded Big Pharma leg. It reflects a durable defensive bid across the sector.
theses.dissent: Health care is crowded alongside staples; a broad risk-on rotation back toward cyclicals or tech would unwind the defensive cohort quickly.

falsifier.text: XLV lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-10 eligible theme with no crowding (0.31) and trend-gate eligibility, offering diversifying leadership away from the crowded defensive block. Breadth is thin (0.0), so this is a fragile trend-health lean rather than a breadth-confirmed one.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth means the trend is carried by very few names; energy is volatile and can mean-revert hard on a single supply or demand headline.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day simple moving average before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
